promptTemplates.bulk: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: single standalone transparent PNG product sprite for a Korean grocery training game. Create exactly ONE {subject}. Style: friendly 2.5D game illustration, warm brown thin outlines, clean cel shading, rounded forms, matching an illustrated Korean grocery catalog. Composition: SQUARE canvas, three-quarter front view, centered entire product with 12% clear margin. Genuine fully transparent alpha outside silhouette. No background scene, no glow, no floor, no cast shadow, no vignette, no checkerboard graphic, no extra unrelated objects, no real brands, no watermark. Recognizable silhouette and color coding at 100 pixels. Korean front label as specified, spelled correctly. Save the one product as a standalone PNG.

promptTemplates.lowFatMilk: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: single transparent PNG product sprite for a Korean grocery training mobile game. Create exactly ONE carton of low-fat milk, 900 mL. Soft friendly 2.5D game illustration, warm dark-brown thin outlines, subtle cel shading, rounded edges; three-quarter front view. Green and cream milk carton, simple milk-drop symbol and small meadow picture, green screw cap. Exact Korean front label: "저지방 우유" with small "1%". Genuine transparent background, no floor, no shadow outside object, no extra items, no logos or watermark. Entire carton centered with 8% transparent margin, large and highly legible at 100px. Save this one product as a standalone image.

refinements.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the reference product sprite only to remove ALL haze/glow/background outside the carton. Keep the existing green and cream low-fat milk carton, green cap, Korean label 저지방 우유, 1%, meadow/cow illustration and 900mL text unchanged. Produce a SQUARE transparent PNG sprite with the entire carton centered and 8% clear margin. Outside the crisp carton silhouette every pixel must have alpha=0: no glow, no haze, no vignette, no floor/shadow, no background color. Do not redraw or change the product design.
